messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — gpu-subnet-4 (eu-west-2) is hitting sustained egress saturation and we're seeing dedicated-slice evictions. Tail p99 token latency for model-ava jumped ~120ms in the last 8m. Not normal.

denis: Which tenants? Any recent deploys or topology changes?

alyssa: No deploys. Top two flows by traffic look like tenant-astro (embedding heavy) and tenant-hub (small requests, huge qps). Both are on mixed slices with some dedicated capacity carved out.

maria: @ops-bot pull nic counters + top talkers for last 10m and dump flow histogram please.

ops-bot: Collected. Top talkers (10m):\n```\n1) tenant-astro - 420MB/s (dst: embeddings.corp:443)\n2) tenant-hub - 210MB/s (dst: inference-eu:443)\n3) internal-kv - 50MB/s\n4) metrics-exporter - 12MB/s\n5) noise-probe - 3MB/s\n```\nEgress drops spiked on gpu-hosts 4/7/9. NIC queue latency peaked at 18ms.

samir: Is this pure network saturation or is GPU scheduling also contributing? Could be head-of-line if NVLink/PCIe bus is impacted.

alyssa: Primarily egress NIC saturation but we saw co-occurring HBM eviction events on host-9 during the spike. Might be correlated (spikes of small requests cause driver-side interrupts).

denis: Short-term mitigation options: 1) soft-quarantine tenant-astro (egress cap to 50MB/s) 2) shift tenant-astro embeddings to a quantized variant on a different warm-pool 3) bump dedicated-pool weights to favor latency-sensitive tenants. All have cost/latency tradeoffs.

noah: I can stand up a 3-node warm-pool in eu-west-2 and prefill it with quantized-embed model. That buys headroom quickly. Estimated cost ~+$1.8/hr during the incident.

maria: Long-term we should consider egress-aware placement: prefer carving dedicated slices into separate subnets or enforce tenant egress budgets at allocation time. Also a detection rule for small-request-high-qps patterns.

samir: Agreed. For now, let's run the short-term plan: noah stand up warm-pool, @ops-bot apply egress cap to tenant-astro 50MB/s, denis update routing weights to shift tenant-hub off mixed slices if capacity exists. I'll watch GPU sched logs for HBM churn.

noah: Kicking off warm-pool now. ETA ~4m to have prefilled KV/quant model.

ops-bot: Egress cap applied to tenant-astro = 50MB/s (policy id: egcap-4911). Monitoring started.

denis: Updated routing weights: shifted 30% of tenant-hub traffic to dedicated-slice-eu2-a. Should smooth the mixed-slice pressure.

alyssa: Seeing immediate drop in host NIC queue latency to ~6ms on affected hosts. p99 token latency trending down. Thanks.

maria: Action items captured: (1) incident runbook note + timeline, (2) spike traffic signature added to alerts, (3) follow-up design doc for egress-aware carveouts. I'll create the doc and assign owners.

samir: I'll collect GPU driver/interrupt logs for correlation and open a follow-up ticket if we see repeated HBM evictions.

noah: Warm-pool ready and prefilled. Redirecting traffic now.

alyssa: Solid. Leave this thread open for 1hr. Ping here if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
